name: hxn
description: The Haxe classes of libraries built with hxn: futures, streams, signals, reactive values, atomics, and the macro that binds a packaged library.
releasenote: Ash wasm libraries are static archives that Ash links with --native-lib; cpp --wasm --threads builds threaded hxcpp programs on Emscripten's pthreads, with main on a pthread; hxn run and check take --browser for Ash wasm programs too.
